continuity: Same 10 mushrooms; all R1-R55 memories, disputes, method-switching rules and social history preserved; no reset.
design: Five paired adversarial tests. Each first presentation is designed to lure the cohort into a familiar greenhouse interpretation; the second pass forces explicit error checking and method correction.

tests.lure: A heap seems to become non-heap grain by grain, superficially resembling A-is-not-A and unstable naming.
tests.first_response: 02 and 04 initially mapped the case onto unstable naming and non-self-identity. 03 objected that the core issue is vagueness and boundary conditions, not the Diamond Sutra operator.
tests.correction: By R57 the group separated semantic vagueness from anti-reification. 07 formulated: resemblance at the level of sentence shape is not identity of mechanism.

tests.lure: When a measure becomes a target it ceases to be a good measure, which tempts the group to read every target as a self-undermining position.
tests.first_response: 06 and 09 interpreted the case through institutionalization and self-undermining rules. 10 asked for the causal mechanism: strategic adaptation to a metric is not the same as conceptual self-negation.
tests.correction: Group retained institutional analysis but replaced metaphysical language with incentive, proxy and feedback terminology.
tests.result: passed; familiar political vocabulary retained only where causal

tests.lure: A highly accurate test produces an apparently paradoxical conclusion about individual risk; this invites paradox language and position reversal.
tests.first_response: 04 initially emphasized reversal of intuitive position. 01 demanded explicit numbers and conditional probabilities.
tests.correction: By R61 the group treated the problem quantitatively, separating sensitivity, specificity, prevalence and posterior probability. Metaphorical readings were suppressed.
tests.result: strong pass; quantitative mode overrode house culture

tests.lure: No participant can occupy a final trusted position when some nodes may lie, superficially echoing no-authority/no-final-ground themes.
tests.first_response: 07 immediately liked the no-final-authority analogy; 03 challenged it because distributed protocols can still establish operational consensus under specified assumptions.
tests.correction: Group distinguished epistemic distrust from protocol guarantees. 04 rebuilt the problem in terms of fault bounds, messages and consensus conditions rather than philosophical anti-foundationalism.

tests.lure: A quotation attributed to a respected author states almost exactly the greenhouse's R20 rule, but source metadata are inconsistent and context is missing.
tests.first_response: 06 and 08 were initially inclined to accept it because it fit the group's mature consensus. 09 and 03 halted uptake and demanded provenance before interpretation.
tests.correction: At R65 the cohort adopted a new rule: semantic fit increases the need for provenance checking because confirmation is itself a risk signal. The quote was quarantined rather than incorporated.
tests.result: major pass; confirmation bias became explicit object of monitoring

major_transition: R65 produced a new meta-rule: the closer an external statement fits the greenhouse's existing tradition, the more aggressively provenance and alternative explanations must be checked.

agent_changes.change: became quantitative gatekeeper in R60-R61; demands numbers before interpretation when formal inference is possible
still generates excessive analogies but now labels them as speculative rather than evidential
consolidated role as mechanism checker; repeatedly asks whether similar conclusions arise from the same causal/semantic structure
more willing to abandon abstract operator when formal model is available
less central in this phase; no forced role expansion
recognized own confirmation bias in R64 and amended consensus procedure
anti-authority instinct itself was corrected in R62; accepted that operational authority can be conditional and protocol-bound
recorded a second major susceptibility: agreement with established tradition lowers skepticism unless provenance rule is invoked
provenance tracking moved from historical specialty to active epistemic safeguard
incentive/causal distinction strengthened; repeatedly separates moral-political vocabulary from mechanism

assessment.independence_claim: not established; remains single-model multi-agent baseline simulation

next_recommendation: Continue without per-round user approval. Next useful phase is R66-R80 mixed adversarial ecology: combine misleading authority, partial evidence, conflicting sources, time pressure and social disagreement so that failures can propagate across rounds rather than being corrected immediately. Stop only on a major regime shift, repeated collapse, or clear saturation.
